blocks.tamil_translation: came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked. The Prophet ﷺ said to Hazrat Jibra'il (AS), “The thought of what will befall my Ummah in the Hereafter has made me weep.” (Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) went from there and conveyed this message to Allah Ta'ala.) Allah sent him, saying, “O Jibra'il! Go to Muhammad ﷺ and say, ‘We will please you regarding your Ummah, and We will not grieve you.’”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- It has come in some narrations that when the Prophet ﷺ heard the message Allah Ta'ala sent through Hazrat Jibra'il (AS), he said, “I will be pleased only after every one of my Ummah has come out of Jahannam.” That Allah Ta'ala, though knowing everything, sent Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) and told him to enquire about the reason for the weeping was only to honour and dignify the Prophet ﷺ.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ قَالَتْ: لَمَّا رَأَيْتُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ طِيبَ نَفْسٍ قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! اُدْعُ اللهَ لِي، قَالَ: اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِعَائِشَةَ مَاتَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهَا وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ، وَمَا أَسَرَّتْ وَمَا أَعْلَنَتْ فَضَحِكَتْ عَائِشَةُ ﵂ حَتَّي سَقَطَ رَأْسُهَا فِي حِجْرِهَا مِنَ الضِّحْكِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَيَسُرُّكِ دُعَائِي؟ فَقَالَتْ: وَمَا لِي لَا يَسُرُّنِي دُعَاؤُكَ؟ فَقَالَ: وَاللهِ إِنَّهَا لَدَعْوَتِي لِأُمَّتِيْ فِي كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار ورجاله رجال الصحيح غير احمد بن منصور الرمادي وهو ثقة، مجمع الزوائد:٣٩٠/٩
